To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the wavelet analysis of MOST photometric data of FU Ori reveals the existence of quasi-periodic features with periods between 2-9 days, which can be explained as the rotation of plasma parcels at different radii in the disc.

(i) FU Ori shows quasi-periodic oscillations (QPO) in its light curve with periods ranging from 2.3 d to 7.7 d; (ii) the QPO periods are decreasing slowly, which may be due spiralling in of the plasma parcels toward the inner radius of the disc; (iii) Z CMa shows no QPO in its light curve, which may be related to its Herbig Be nature.
FU Ori shows quasi-periodic variations in the optical with periods from 2-9 days, while Z CMa does show such variability, but the periodogram of its light curve is dominated by the outburst.
